description_en: View details for all Global Database Networks (GDNs) in your account
description_zh: 查看账号下所有全球数据库网络（GDN）的详情
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-global-database-networks --filter-region cn-beijing --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --gdn-description test --gdn-id gdn-0000000000000000 --resource-group-id rg-000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeGlobalDatabaseNetworks

parameters.help_en: Returns only GDNs that support creating a secondary cluster in the specified region
parameters.help_zh: 查询可以在指定Region创建从集群的GDN列表
parameters.name: filter_region

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to find the IDs of all clusters in a region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 30. Valid values:

30

50

100
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数。默认值为30，取值如下：

30
50
100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码。默认值为1，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The description of the GDN. The description must meet the following requirements:

It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

It must start with a letter or a Chinese character.

It can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

It must be 2 to 126 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
GDN描述。要求如下：

不能以http://或https://开头。

必须以大小写字母或中文开头。

可以包含大小写字母、中文、数字、下划线（_）或连字符（-）。

长度为2~126个字符
parameters.name: gdn_description

CreateTime.description_en: The time at which the GDN was created, in UTC. The format is `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ`

DBClusters.description_en: A list of clusters in the GDN

Role.description_en:
The role of the cluster. Valid values:

primary: The primary cluster.

standby: The standby cluster.

A GDN consists of one primary cluster and up to four standby clusters. For more information, see [Global Database Network]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160381.html）
Role.description_zh:
集群角色，取值范围如下：
primary：主集群
standby：从集群

一个GDN中包含一个主集群和最多四个从集群。更多信息，请参见[全球数据库网络（GDN）]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160381.html）

DBType.description_en: The database engine type. Only MySQL is supported
DBType.description_zh: 数据库引擎类型，当前仅支持MySQL类型

DBVersion.description_en: The database engine version. Only version 8.0 is supported
DBVersion.description_zh: 数据库引擎版本号，当前仅支持8.0版本

GDNDescription.description_en:
The GDN description. Requirements:

Cannot start with http\:// or https\://.

Must start with a letter or a Chinese character.

Can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, underscores (_), or hyphens (-).

Must be 2 to 126 characters long
GDNDescription.description_zh:
GDN描述。要求如下：

不能以http://或https://开头。

必须以大小写字母或中文开头。

可以包含大小写字母、中文、数字、下划线（_）或连字符（-）。

长度为2~126个字符

GDNStatus.description_en:
The status of the GDN. Valid values:

creating: The GDN is being created.

active: The GDN is running.

deleting: The GDN is being deleted.

locked: The GDN is locked. This status prevents any operations on clusters in the GDN.

removing_member: A standby cluster is being removed from the GDN
GDNStatus.description_zh:
GDN状态，取值范围如下：
creating：创建中
active：运行中
deleting：删除中
locked：锁定中（此时无法对GDN下的任一集群执行任何操作）
removing_member：从集群正在脱离GDN

Labels.description_en: The tags applied to the GDN

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of records on the current page
